external.description: Apple has finally launched its foldable phone - the iPhone Duo. It collapses to palm-size and unfolds into a tablet screen. While solving the bulky brick issue, it arrives late to a crowded market against Samsung and others. Starting at over €2000, it costs more than some Galaxy Z Fold alternatives. Critics are split on whether it will challenge Android rivals or disappoint users. Apple is already reimagining stores for spatial computing and foldables. Though expensive and imperfect, Apple has always made trends normal. Will your grandma want a flip iPhone? Watch now before it's too late.
